view.description: testing the xpan cam some more. these are mostly set to the ektar 100 film simulation i made calibrated with the open source rawtherapee luts and ektar xpan samples from flickr. figured out a way to get raw image data out of the arducam 5mp and updated the processing algo to try to get the sharpest image. looks pretty good honestly. basically film scan quality for a camera that weighs nothing and the battery lasts seemingly forever
